payload.description_html: Reconstructions of some animals from Monte San Giorgio by Beat Scheffold. Note that not all of the depicted taxa may have co-occurred in time or in space (habitat depth, etc.). At Monte San Giorgio, the water depth was likely greater then shown in these images: Besano Formation (Anisian).
